model_annotation: This bar chart illustrates the “effect” (y-axis, ranging from 0 to 30 with major ticks at intervals of 10) of six different language models — mBERT-L₂, XLM-L₂, mBERT-R₂, XLM-R₂, mBERT-B₂, and XLM-B₂ — across nine language families or groups (x-axis: IE-Baltic, IE-Germanic, IE-Indic, IE-Romance, IE-Slavic family, IE-other, Isolate, Semitic, Uralic). Each group on the x-axis contains six vertically stacked bars, color-coded according to the legend in the upper right: light blue for mBERT-L₂, dark blue for XLM-L₂, light green for mBERT-R₂, dark green for XLM-R₂, light pink for mBERT-B₂, and red for XLM-B₂. Error bars extend vertically from each bar, indicating variability or confidence intervals. The height of each bar represents the magnitude of the effect for that model within the respective language group. For example, in the IE-Indic group, XLM-B₂ (red) shows the highest effect (approximately 21), while mBERT-L₂ (light blue) shows the lowest (around 1). In contrast, for the Isolate group, all models show very low effects (near 0), with minimal variation. The Semitic group shows a wide range, with XLM-B₂ again near 20 and mBERT-R₂ near -2. The Uralic group shows uniformly low effects across all models. The chart does not sort the language groups by effect size; they appear in a fixed categorical order. No bars are highlighted or emphasized beyond their color coding and error bars.
